QuestInfo.name: [Maple Music Festival] Crumpled Flyer
QuestInfo.1: I need you to flatten out some fliers for me.

0.1: Can I ask you for a favor? I made this flier for the Maple Music Festival, but I got so pumped and accidentally crumpled it.
0.2: \r Can you take this #b#eCrumpled MMF Flier#n#k and straighten it out? Just keep it with you for #b#e30 mins#n#k, and bring it to me. I will give you this #e#bGift Box#k#n that I worked hard putting together. \r\nHow about it? Will you do it?

yes.0: Let it air out for 30 mins to un-crumple the creases. Be warned, it'll disappear if you log out!

no.0: You can only un-crumple one flier a day. Think it over.

item.0: The folds should straighten out if you hold onto the crumpled MMF flier for 30 min. It looks like it's still kind of crumpled.
